versions.changelog:
- Added a new section inviting users to share their projects and contact InspiredHub.
- No other significant content changes.

- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
- Updated SKILL.md to include prominent links to a live demo and clearer calls to try the skill before installation.
- Added new sections highlighting how to preview the skill on InspiredHub without an account.
- No changes to core style tokens, anti-tokens, application rules, or exemplar works.

- README.md and skill.json files have been removed.
- SKILL.md was revised: the format is more structured, with expanded overview and exemplar works.
- Style tokens and anti-tokens are now listed in concise bullet point format.
- Added explicit evaluation criteria and a confidence threshold.
- Example downloads have been noted for key Shakespeare works.
- Author attribution now references the InspiredHub Taste Engine in the footer.
Renamed display name to Taste Shakespeare
Added YAML frontmatter for consistency with other skills. Fixed Get the Full Skill link to point to specific skill page.
Fix README: remove trailing period after markdown link to prevent /taste). malformed URL parsing

Re-distilled from real Gutenberg text (Hamlet, Macbeth, Romeo and Juliet). 10 style tokens, 5 anti-tokens, 3 signature passages, and 4 application rule categories — all extracted from Shakespeare's actual works.

- Initial release of the "taste-shakespeare" skill, version 1.0.0.
- Provides distilled style tokens and creative direction from 111 Shakespearean works.
- Includes guidance on literary devices, writing style, and influences from French, Spanish, Greek, and Latin traditions.
- Outlines anti-tokens to avoid styles incompatible with Shakespeare's aesthetic.
- Offers example applications in copywriting, branding, and creative writing.
- Preview version—full skill available via InspiredHub.
